            Changing accessType on an existing workflow is rejected by  (PATCH/PUT); omit on POST to default to PSA.

emailRecipient.description: Required when notifyWho is set to: "Email Address" Max length: 250;

emailFrom.description: Required when notifyFrom is set to: "Email Address" Max length: 250;

subject.description:
Required when notifyType is set to: "Create Activity", "Send Email", "Assign Resource", "Publish to Platform".
            When notifyType identifier is PP (Publish to Platform), this field holds the platform workflow identifier. Max length: 100;

attachConfigurationsFor.description: Required when notifyType is set to: "Attach Configuration"

frequencyUnit.description: Required when exectionTimes is set to MultipleTimes or Continuously

frequencyOfExecution.description: Required when exectionTimes is set to MultipleTimes or Continuously

maxNumberOfExecution.description: Required when exectionTimes is set to MultipleTimes

executionTime.description: Defaults to Once when not specified

isSetupFlag.description: If the current action is available because it is already set up. Pertains to integrations such as Automate

externalFlag.description: If the current action effects external objects e.g. integrations or sending an email

maxResults.description: Maximum number of result rows returned. The full match count is still reported in .

results.description: Up to  rows (or the server default), each a dictionary of column name to value.

totalCount.description: Total number of rows that satisfied the condition, regardless of how many appear in .
